items.title: Vasoconstriction and Vasodilation in Arterioles (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Vasoconstriction and Vasodilation in Arterioles: a main subheading of 11.2 Blood vessels, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 244-244.

blocks.text: Arterioles ki deewaron mein elastic tissue ke muqable mein gol (circular) muscles zyada hote hain. In circular muscles ka sukarna nervous system aur endocrine system (hormones wala nizam) ke control mein hai. Jab yeh muscles sukarte hain to arterioles tang ho jati hain. Isay vasoconstriction kehte hain; is se arterioles mein khoon ka bahao kam ho jata hai. Jab yeh muscles dheele hote hain to arterioles chauri ho jati hain. Isay vasodilation kehte hain; is se un mein khoon ka bahao barh jata hai.

Vasoconstriction aur vasodilation tissues ki metabolic activity (cells ke kaam ki raftar) badalne par hoti hain. Maslan jab kisi tissue ki metabolic activity barhti hai to us ke interstitial fluid mein oxygen kam aur carbon dioxide zyada ho jati hai. Is ke jawab mein us tissue ki arterioles ke circular muscles dheele ho jate hain (vasodilation). Is se in arterioles aur capillaries mein khoon ka bahao barh jata hai. Zyada khoon zyada oxygen lata hai aur zyada carbon dioxide le jata hai. Isi tarah metabolic activity kam ho to arterioles mein vasoconstriction hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Faal (active) tissue cells ki qatar ke neeche do arterioles. Baen: tang arteriole jis se capillaries mein normal blood flow hai; oopar tissue fluid mein oxygen zyada hai. Daen: tissue fluid mein oxygen kam aur carbon dioxide zyada hai, aur chauri phaili (dilated) arteriole capillaries mein zyada khoon le jati hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jab tissue zyada kaam kare to O2 kam aur CO2 zyada hoti hai; is ke jawab mein arteriole ke circular muscles dheele hote hain (vasodilation) aur zyada khoon aa kar zyada O2 deta hai.
